name: Hanzuni
slug: Ancient copper dragon of Haven Hold who loans gold for quests
description: Hanzuni (H-A-Z-U-N-I) is an ancient male copper dragon and one of two ancient copper dragons Walker has met on The Reach. He is relatively small for an ancient dragon, with polished copper scales from swimming in his hoard at Haven Hold and less tarnish than Araden thanks to constant activity among treasure. He swims through the hoard and offers low-interest loans repaid as quests. Magical hoard items that could cure exhaustion require a Sunder Chase to remove, though plain gold can be loaned out. He knows Quaylin and that Quaylin may haggle if offered pickled alabaster herring.

log.summary: Walker and Glimmen visit Hanzuni at Haven Hold seeking exhaustion relief funding. Hanzuni greets Glimmen first—remembering her as a hatchling—and has forgotten Walker's name. He perceives shimmering magical energy on Walker, criticizes his mismatched star gem earrings, and offers matching gems in trade, which Walker declines. Hanzuni removes Walker's plated gold hand and identifies it as pure gold weighing roughly thirty pounds, says hoard cures for exhaustion require a Sunder Chase, and offers twelve hundred gold in exchange for an island crab. Walker declines the race due to time pressure, cites Quaylin's referral, and accepts the quest-based loan; Glimmen swims in the hoard when invited.

log.summary: Walker finishes speaking with Hanzuni in the hoard room at Haven Hold and leaves. The DM calls Hanzuni the hoard master of Haven Hold.
